title: Where Entropy Is Measured Matters: Policy Geometry in Bounded Continuous-Control PPO
abstract: arXiv:2608.24488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many continuous-control policies are optimized as unbounded Gaussians and then mapped into bounded actions. We show that where entropy is measured changes the policy geometry learned by proximal policy optimization (PPO). In an 80-muscle MyoLeg task, a clipped Gaussian executes 89.07% of actions within 5% of a bound. A same-state decomposition shows that this is not due to variance alone: setting variance to zero still leaves 83.83% of actions near a bound, while 82.12% of state-conditioned means lie outside the executable interval. Replacing clipping with a tanh map does not remove the high-variance regime. For latent Gaussian entropy H(u), the entropy loss has zero gradient with respect to the mean and a constant variance-increasing gradient. For executed-action entropy H(a), the transform Jacobian adds an inward gradient on the mean. Across three matched MyoLeg seeds, near-boundary occupancy is 71.42%, 29.76%, and 18.83% under latent

translated_title: 熵的测量位置至关重要：有界连续控制PPO中的策略几何
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24488v1 公告类型：新  摘要：许多连续控制策略被优化为无界高斯分布，然后映射到有界动作空间。我们表明，熵的测量位置改变了近端策略优化（PPO）所学习的策略几何。在一个80肌肉的MyoLeg任务中，裁剪高斯分布有89.07%的动作在边界的5%范围内执行。同状态分解显示，这并非仅由方差导致：将方差设为零后，仍有83.83%的动作接近边界，而82.12%的状态条件均值位于可执行区间之外。用tanh映射替代裁剪并不能消除高方差状态。对于潜在高斯熵H(u)，熵损失对均值具有零梯度，并具有恒定的方差增加梯度。对于执行动作熵H(a)，变换雅可比矩阵在均值上增加了内向梯度。在三个匹配的MyoLeg种子中，潜在熵下的近边界占用率分别为71.42%、29.76%和18.83%。
tldr: 本文发现，在连续控制PPO中，熵的测量位置（潜在空间还是执行动作空间）显著影响策略几何，导致有界动作空间中高比例的动作靠近边界，并揭示了这一现象的梯度机制。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the location of entropy measurement (latent vs. executed action space) significantly alters policy geometry in bounded continuous-control PPO, causing high near-boundary action occupancy, and identifies the underlying gradient mechanisms.
